title: Money
description: Class 1 IMO — Money: Indian coins and notes, counting money and simple buying, with olympiad reasoning and everyday-maths practice.

topics.title: Coins and Notes
topics.concept: In India we use rupees (₹). We have coins such as ₹1, ₹2, ₹5 and ₹10, and notes such as ₹10, ₹20, ₹50 and ₹100. Coins are made of metal and notes are made of paper.

examples.problem: Is ₹100 a coin or a note?

recap: Indian money is counted in rupees (₹).

quiz.q: Which of these is a coin?
quiz.explanation: ₹5 is a coin; the others are notes.

quiz.q: What symbol do we use for rupees?
quiz.explanation: ₹ is the symbol for the Indian rupee.

topics.title: Counting Money
topics.concept: To find how much money you have, add the values together. Two ₹5 coins make ₹5 + ₹5 = ₹10. A ₹10 note and a ₹5 coin make ₹10 + ₹5 = ₹15.

examples.problem: How much is one ₹10 note and one ₹20 note?

recap: Count money by adding the values.
Coins and notes are added the same way.

topics.title: Buying and Change
topics.concept: When we buy something, we pay money. If we pay more than the price, we get back the extra as change. Change = money given − price.

examples.problem: A pencil costs ₹4. You pay ₹5. How much change?
A toffee costs ₹2. You buy 3. How much do you pay?

recap: To buy more than one, add up the costs.

quiz.q: An eraser costs ₹3. You give ₹5. How much change do you get?
Two pens cost ₹5 each. What is the total cost?

questions.q: Odd one out — which of these is NOT a coin?
A ₹2 coin is to metal as a ₹50 note is to ___ ?
questions.explanation: Coins are metal; notes are paper.

questions.q: A chocolate costs ₹15. Riya pays with a ₹20 note. How much change?
Aarav buys 2 samosas at ₹10 each. How much does he pay?
A pencil is ₹4 and an eraser is ₹3. What is the total cost?
Meera has one ₹10 note and two ₹5 coins. How much money does she have in all?
A toy costs ₹18. You pay with a ₹20 note. With the change, how many ₹1 toffees can you buy?
questions.explanation: Change = ₹20 − ₹18 = ₹2, which buys 2 toffees of ₹1 each.
